title: (fix) O3-5914: Preserve saved location attributes while searching
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration. - [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary Editing a patient whose saved location isn't in the first ten search results shows an empty location field. Typing in it sets the value to `null`, so saving deletes the attribute. Saving without touching the field fails with a 400, because the REST API rejects the `{ uuid, display }` reference we send back. Build the selection from the saved value instead of the search results, and store picks in the same `{ uuid, display }` shape. Only change the value when the user picks another location or clears the field. Keep Downshift's selection in sync through `downshiftActions`, since Carbon's ComboBox doesn't pass `selectedItem` on to it and the field would otherwise go blank on blur. Keep the saved location when Enter matches no option, which Carbon reports as a cleared selection. In `getPatientAttributes`, send the uuid for reference values and leave other values, such as booleans, as they were loaded. Tested against a local backend with a Location attribute configured as a registration field. Searching, pressing Enter on a search with no match, and saving without touching the field all keep the saved location. Picking another location saves it, and clearing the field removes the attribute. ## Screenshots Editing a patient whose saved Health Center is Site 23, which isn't in the first ten search results. Both screenshots are after searching "Ward" and leaving the field without picking anything. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89126cb2-8efc-4849-b586-0e6c09584759 ### Before: The field is empty, and saving deletes the attribute. ### After: The field still shows Site 23, and saving keeps it. ## Related Issue https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-5914 ## Other Pressing Escape on a closed menu still empties the input without changing the value. Carbon does the same on main.
